systems.system: digitalisation du registre de la population de Kinshasa
systems.country_label: registre de la population de Kinshasa
systems.platform: data collected by census agents and centralised on a compilation server
systems.owner: provincial authorities of Kinshasa (provincial interior minister), with support from partners including UNICEF
systems.tiers: city-province of Kinshasa; census agents drawn from the communes collect in households; launched 4 November 2025

note: A population-register application launched by Kinshasa's provincial government; commune agents collect door to door and the data goes to a central server, but the document does not say commune offices are connected or that staff work online from them, so no fact is taken.
